title: Is your AI tool subscription a business write-off?
label: AI in tax

beats.sub: Common in your field, helpful for your business.

items.t: Note what you use it for

cta.sub: We'll DM you our Is It Deductible? tool.

captions.instagram:
Paying monthly for an AI tool? Whether it's deductible comes down to how you use it.

✔️ The IRS test: a business expense must be ordinary (common and accepted in your field) and necessary (helpful and appropriate for your business).
✔️ Used for client work, content or bookkeeping? Generally a business expense.
✔️ Used for personal things? Personal expenses generally aren't deductible. Used for both, only the business share counts.
✔️ Pay with the business card, keep the invoices, and note what you use it for.

Check other expenses with our Is It Deductible? tool.

sources.fact: IRS: 'An ordinary expense is one that is common and accepted in your industry. A necessary expense is one that is helpful and appropriate for your trade or business.'; read 2026-10-30
Personal, living or family expenses are generally not deductible; separate business and personal accounts make records easier (IRS FAQ, page updated 30-Sep-2026; read 2026-10-24, within 30 days)
